build.buildCommand: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: bash -lc 'echo "SERVICE_MODE=${SERVICE_MODE:-unset}"; echo "RUN_MIGRATIONS=${RUN_MIGRATIONS:-false}"; echo "START_COMMAND=${START_COMMAND:-<auto>}"; if [ -n "${START_COMMAND}" ]; then exec bash -lc "${START_COMMAND}"; fi; if [ "${SERVICE_MODE:-API}" = "BOT" ]; then exec python bot.py; fi; exec uvicorn web.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}'
